title: Extract files from a tar archive
summary: Unpack the contents of a .tar, .tar.gz, or .tar.xz archive. You can extract to the current folder or specify a target directory.

steps.explain: Extract the contents of the archive into the current directory. The 'v' flag shows the files as they are extracted.

placeholders.name: ARCHIVE_FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the archive file to extract

alternatives.explain: Extract the contents into a specific target directory instead of the current one.

placeholders.name: ARCHIVE_FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the archive file to extract

placeholders.name: TARGET_DIR
placeholders.description: The directory where files should be extracted

alternatives.explain: Extract only files matching a specific pattern (e.g., only .html files) from the archive.

placeholders.name: ARCHIVE_FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the archive file to extract
